title: Odonate (dragonfly and damselfly) nymph counts at 16 ponds in Ocala National Forest, Florida, four dipnet visits 2022-2023 (without Libellula jesseana, coordinates as deposited)
creator: Work, Kirsten; Ray, H. A.
citation: Work, K. (2026). Odonate species richness and abundance in Ocala National Forest ponds [Dataset]. Harvard Dataverse, V1. https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/M7XVVL
abstract: Counts of nymphs of 40 odonate species collected with dipnets at 16 ponds in four spatial groups in Ocala National Forest, Florida, on four visits (May and August 2022, June and August 2023), with pond size, depth, isolation, vegetation and fish / crayfish presence. Collected to test whether assemblages are more similar in nearby ponds and which ecological variables predict assemblage structure; adults collected with aerial nets on the same visits are a sibling table. This table omits Libellula jesseana (IUCN VU) so that pond names and coordinates ship as deposited.
samplingProtocol: Nymphs collected with dipnets at each pond on each visit; adults with aerial nets (sibling table). Number of sweeps, time or area per visit is not given in the deposit.
closureNote: none assumed: two visits two to three months apart within a summer; nymph cohorts grow and emerge between visits, so counts are not replicate counts of a closed population
geographicCoverage: Ocala National Forest, Marion County, Florida, USA (29.12-29.33 N, 81.61-81.74 W)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: As deposited (degrees-minutes-seconds to 0.01 s, converted to decimal degrees): Libellula jesseana (IUCN VU) is not in this table (E7.3)

notes: Visit months only (obs_survey_month); no day, so no `date`. The Dataverse description says summers 2021 and 2023; the sheets say 2022 and 2023 and are followed. Six source spellings corrected for GBIF (Argia moesta, Coryphaeschna ingens, Nasiaeschna pentacantha, Pachydiplax longipennis, Epitheca cynosura, Gomphus cavillaris); the source spelling is in __taxa taxon_sourceName. Species collected only as adults are not listed (taxonInclusion = recorded). Counts are not standardised for effort, which the deposit does not give. Hopkins pond 3's coordinate string has a stray trailing '7', dropped. Sampling effort per visit is not in the deposit.

notShipped.two blank species columns: unlabelled and empty in both stage sheets
notShipped.species never collected as nymphs: 4 species of the 45-column list never collected in this table (only as adults): Lestes australis, Libellula axilena, Libellula incesta, Perithemis tenera
notShipped.LIBJES: Libellula jesseana (IUCN VU): in work_2026_ocala_odonatenymphs_count only, whose coordinates are coarsened
